nonblocking_findings: F1 [Minor] measure/tech-stack.md S3 note (added at 3effc7e4, final text at 5d91443c lines 197-199) states a contract the final tree does not hold: the root declares `typescript` `^7.0.2` in devDependencies and in overrides, and bus-math-v2 gets the tsrs app script. At the audited head the root devDependencies hold `@typescript/native` (npm alias) and no `typescript`, the overrides block is removed, and bus-math-v2 runs `tsc --noEmit`. The deviation is recorded in oxc-evidence section 7/8 and the tech-debt row, but a reader of tech-stack.md alone gets a wrong current state. Fix: add one dated line to the note that names the final state.

F2 [Nit] measure/tech-debt.md line 42 (row 'IM3 typecheck exhausts the default Node heap') still says the typecheck script carries the heap setting (b9d27742). S3 set the IM3 script to plain `tsc --noEmit` on the native tsc 7.0.2, so the setting is gone and the Node heap limit no longer applies. The row is stale; close it or annotate it with the S3 change.

F3 [Nit] oxc-evidence.md lines 624-627 say the Convex CLI rows 'tsc 7.0.2 runs through node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc and reports the pre-existing convex project diagnostics'. A re-run of `npx convex typecheck` in IM1, IM3, and PreCalc exits 1 and prints only bundler loader errors for the pre-existing katex CSS side-effect import; no tsc diagnostic line prints and no skip line prints. The exit code and the pre-existing substance are verified; the mechanism sentence is not supported by the output. The keep decision rests on the subset rule, so no change is blocking.

F4 [Nit] oxc-evidence.md line 391 says the raw after values sit in `s3-tsrs-raw.txt` (23 workspaces). The file holds 27 sections: 23 tsrs runs plus 4 warm-cache tsc rows; the 4 used fallback medians come from `s3-tsc-after-raw.txt` (tsbuildinfo deleted per run). Bookkeeping precision only; the medians in the table recompute correctly from the raw files.

No S3 case body changed. S1 cases 5, 5b, 6 changed only at the Red commit, as plan line 363 allows; the Red log records their planned red reasons.

S3 case text matches strategy 16.2/16.3: case 0 asserts the exact alias spec, resolves `typescript6/package.json` through createRequire, parses the major as an integer (A3), and checks the parser API; case 1 uses exact-string equality against the target form with `--config ../../.oxlintrc.json` and lists wrong folders (A3/A7); case 4 matches a command-form regex with one map entry per workflow file (A4/A7); case 6 asserts the exit code, TS2322, and no ABSENT_TOOL_PHRASES with a `tsrs --version` precondition (A4).

Fallback claim verified with real output: PreCalc tsrs reports 6 rows that equal the union of its tsc app rows (4) and convex rows (2); IM1 tsrs reports 21 rows that equal its convex rows; both app configs are clean. BM2 app config is clean (0 rows) and its convex config holds 87 rows. IM3 tsrs reports 38 rows in `scripts/scale/run.mjs` and `scripts/validate-seed-integrity.mjs` that match the evidence gap table line by line (TS2591 8, TS7006 20, TS7053 3, TS2591 4, TS7006 3).

No behavior-neutral fix exists for the IM3 gap rows: each row needs `node` in the app `types` list or a rewrite of the `.mjs` scripts, and both change what tsc checks. The app tsconfig `include` covers only `*.ts`/`*.tsx`, so tsc never checks the `.mjs` files. The disposition and the fallback follow plan lines 402-404.

Raw sets match the section 7 tables: tsc70.txt and tsc71.txt each hold 158 rows (BM2 71, IM3 60, IM1 21, PreCalc 6) and a set diff gives 0 rows only in 7.0.2 and 0 only in 7.1.0-beta, which proves the compiler-version table. tsc-diff.txt reports `new_keys=0 gone_keys=0` for all 33 configs.

IM3 stays as strong as before: `npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/integrated-math-3` in the main checkout exits 1 with 55 error TS lines and no cloudflare/worker.ts line; the count matches the baseline 55 and tsc-diff. The worktree run showed 56 only because a fresh worktree lacks the untracked `apps/integrated-math-3/dist/`; that is environmental, not a work defect. The heap flag is no longer needed because tsc 7.0.2 is the native compiler.

Lists and manifests match: `TYPESCRIPT_KEEP_LIST` names the only 4 manifests that declare `typescript` (apps/bus-math-v2, integrated-math-1, integrated-math-3, pre-calculus, all `^7.0.2`); `TSC_FALLBACK_LIST` names the same 4 folders, so the subset rule holds; 23 workspaces run the tsrs form and 4 run `tsc --noEmit`.

Aliases verified: `npx tsc --version` prints 7.0.2; `node_modules/.bin/tsc` links to `../@typescript/native/bin/tsc` (7.0.2); `typescript6` resolves to 6.0.2 (major 6); `@typescript/old` 6.0.3 exists and provides the documented bin shadow; `npx tsrs --version` prints the 7.1.0-beta line. `npm ls typescript --all` shows only 7.0.2 copies and the convex-helpers peer is optional (peerDependenciesMeta read).

Timing evidence is honest: the after table records tsrs 4.30 s for danielson (ratio 0.74 against the 6.0.3 before value 5.8), the separate tsc 7.0.2 table records danielson 1.1 s, several tsrs ratios are above 1 (activity-runtime 1.07, component-approval 1.08, _template 1.47), and neither the spec nor the tech-stack note claims tsrs is faster. The raw files recompute the medians (danielson tsrs 4.470/4.020/4.301; IM3 before 22.948/22.350/22.399; BM2 after 2.433/2.293/2.382).

Section 9 CLI facts verified: `node_modules/convex/dist/esm/cli/lib/typecheck.js` holds `findTypeScriptCompilerPath` (line 110), the `tsgo` case (116-118), the `tsc` case with `@typescript/native/bin/tsc` first and the alias comment (122-128), and the skip message (90-94).
